cohort: 170 women with preterm pre-labour rupture of membranes (PPROM) at less than 37 weeks gestation, who were managed expectantly and received one of two prophylactic antibiotic protocols.
finding: Cefuroxime plus azithromycin as prophylaxis for PPROM at <37(0) weeks showed fewer maternal peripartum infectious outcomes and better bacteriologic findings compared to ampicillin plus roxithromycin.
mod_finding: The earlier antibiotic regimen (ampicillin and roxithromycin) was associated with higher rates of cesarean delivery compared to the later regimen (cefuroxime and azithromycin).
